0022600201.text: The Clippers (1-7, on a seven-game losing streak and 13th in the West) host the Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game winning streak and 10th in the West) in LA's ninth game of the season, with the Clippers 1-3 at home and New Orleans 1-2 on the road. LA is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Clippers losing the last meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026.
